import sys

mod = 10**9 + 7

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    p = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    if k == 0:
        ret = pow(p, p - 1, mod)
    elif k == 1:
        ret = pow(p, p, mod)
    else:
        l = 1
        cur = k % p
        while cur != 1:
            cur = (cur * k) % p
            l += 1
        ret = pow(p, (p - 1) // l, mod)
    print(ret)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
